video_title: An Offseason Mailbag with Cam Johnson! | Wemby and Brunson’s Finals, Playing With Jokic & More

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Cam Johnson on Jalen Brunson's clutch performance and championship impact
quotes.excerpt: He deserves a ton of respect as a first option and have huge shots along the entire playoff journey.

text_blocks.speaker: Tommy Alter
text_blocks.text: Where does Jalen Brunson rank for you in terms of clutch scorers ever?

text_blocks.speaker: Cam Johnson
text_blocks.text: He deserves a ton of respect. He has a lot of moments that you can point to of being clutch. For him to go bring a championship to New York as a first option and have huge shots along the entire playoff journey, it speaks for itself.

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Cam Johnson on Dylan Harper's potential and recent performance
quotes.excerpt: That's a lot of momentum off a finals run that.
quotes.quote: The player I think is Dylan Harper. That's a lot of momentum off a finals run that. It is a very cheap answer, but he deserves a ton of respect.

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Cam Johnson on the Utah Jazz's potential for improvement
quotes.excerpt: It seems like Utah is kind of poised to be a lot better.
quotes.quote: It seems like Utah is kind of poised to be a lot better. It depends on what happens with Walker Kessler and stuff like that, but you could see their anticipated lineup being really interesting. When you have Lauri Markkanen, Jalen Duren, Walker Kessler, there is a lot of versatility, a lot of size. That might be an interesting experiment.

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Cam Johnson on Joel Embiid's reaction to losing the finals
quotes.excerpt: He is not happy. He lost the finals.
quotes.quote: He is not happy. He lost the finals. There is something to be said about sportsmanship and bowing out with grace and all that, but people are quick to pick at Joel Embiid's antics. I don't hate it. He is not an ill-willed guy. He is a competitor. He wanted to win really bad and it hurts that you lose. You lose on your home court. It is a sting.

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Cam Johnson on Peyton Watson's role as the team connector
quotes.excerpt: Peyton Watson is like a younger guy, funny guy, kind of the connector.
quotes.quote: Peyton Watson is like a younger guy, funny guy, kind of the connector that brings a little bit of the humor to it. I would give that nod to Peyton Watson.

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Cam Johnson on the Dallas Cowboys' massive fan base
quotes.excerpt: It is still a mega fan base with such little playoff success recently.
quotes.quote: It is still a mega fan base with such little playoff success recently. It is arguably the biggest fan base in professional football, which is the biggest sport we have here.

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Cam Johnson on the value of championships in the modern era
quotes.excerpt: I would argue that they are kind of valued a little bit more.
quotes.quote: I would argue that they are kind of valued a little bit more. I think it is a sports talk show's job to be controversial like that. It adds something to talk about. I would argue the opposite. I would argue it is even harder to win because if you are a dynasty team like the Warriors, you are kind of expected to win.

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Cam Johnson compares Olivia Miles' playing style to Austin Reaves
quotes.excerpt: She plays just like Austin Reaves. She plays, moves like Austin Reaves.
quotes.quote: I saw her play at the Mercury a couple weeks ago. She is really, really good. She plays just like Austin Reaves. She plays, moves like Austin Reaves. Put clips side by side, their style, their movement, how they attack is very similar in my opinion.

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Cam Johnson predicts the Cincinnati Bengals will reach the Super Bowl
quotes.excerpt: I'm taking Ja'Marr Chase. I'm telling you, Bengals going to the Super Bowl.
quotes.quote: I'm taking Ja'Marr Chase. I'm telling you, Bengals going to the Super Bowl.

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Cam Johnson on Jaylen Watson's potential in Kansas City
quotes.excerpt: I hope he is good. He is good and he will just and they.
quotes.quote: I hope he is good. He is good and he will just and they. I just hope they didn't do him like they did him in Seattle. They didn't give him the goal line touches. They didn't let his stats match his productivity.

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Cam Johnson on Jrue Holiday's defensive impact
quotes.excerpt: Defensively, somebody like Jrue Holiday, especially as a prime and his prime as a defender.
quotes.quote: Defensively, somebody like Jrue Holiday, especially as a prime and his prime as a defender. He doesn't get in his stance in front of you and he is just really good with anticipation, beats you to spots, feet are always moving, it is physical, cuts off angles, it is tough.

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Cam Johnson on Luka Doncic and Jalen Brunson's offensive skill
quotes.excerpt: The people that are really, really good at attacking angles, think Luka, think Jalen Brunson.
quotes.quote: The people that are really, really good at attacking angles, think Luka, think Jalen Brunson. Think when Paul George at his best, really good at attacking angles. James Harden, you are so worried about that step back, he has this, he has that. He is trying to bait you into this, he is trying to trick you into this, and that is when you get to thinking a lot as a defender.
